clue.text: Twilight start to drive by Welsh river

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter, so this takes the opening letter of drive

parts.note: the Usk is a river in south Wales

explanation.surface: Setting off at nightfall for a drive along a river in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Dusk is the dim part of evening after sunset, a synonym for twilight.

clue.text: Factotum one sort of boxer would have

definitions.meaning: a person given all the menial jobs

definitions.text: one sort of boxer would have
definitions.meaning: a boxer is a breed of dog

explanation.definitionFit: A factotum is a general helper who does every kind of job, much like the drudge called a dogsbody.

clue.text: Loose garment some initially laugh at

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of some

parts.note: to mock is to laugh at

explanation.surface: A baggy outfit that some people find funny.
explanation.definitionFit: A smock is a loose overgarment, such as an artist's or farmworker's overall.

clue.text: Enchanting girl entering Italian island from east

indicators.note: the girl's name goes into the island's name, splitting it
in an across clue, reading from the east means right to left, so the island is read backwards

parts.note: Elba is the Italian island where Napoleon was exiled
Dora is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A charming young woman arriving on an Italian island from the eastern side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from east' means reading right to left in an across answer, so the island comes out as ABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something adorable is delightful and charming, a close synonym of enchanting.

clue.text: New inn dominated by duke's small terrier

parts.note: D is an abbreviation for duke

indicators.note: making something new remakes it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A new inn overshadowed by an aristocrat's little dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' is the anagram signal, making ANDIEDINMONT; the surface reads it as describing the inn.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dandie Dinmont is a small Scottish terrier breed named after a character in Scott's Guy Mannering.

clue.text: Shakespearean hero with capital O

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy

explanation.surface: A leading man from Shakespeare paired with a capital letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: Romeo is the hero of Shakespeare's tragedy Romeo and Juliet.

clue.text: Asian girl visiting W African state endlessly

indicators.note: a visitor goes inside, so the girl goes into the shortened state
without its end, so the final letter of the country is dropped

parts.note: Benin is a country in West Africa
gal is an informal word for a girl

explanation.surface: A girl from Asia paying a visit to a West African country without end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' leaves BENI, which 'visiting' opens up after its third letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bengali is a person from Bengal, in Bangladesh and eastern India, so an Asian.

clue.text: Peer demanding attention last of all

parts.note: to have someone's ear is to have their attention

indicators.note: last of takes the final letter of all

explanation.surface: A nobleman insisting on being listened to, after everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: An earl is a British nobleman, so a member of the peerage.

clue.text: American chap pinches gold, having no principles

indicators.note: to pinch is to steal and hold, so the gold is taken inside

parts.note: Al is a man's name, a chap
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: An unscrupulous American man stealing gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Amoral means lacking any moral sense, without principles of right and wrong.

clue.text: Title of head of household once — Benny, possibly?

definitions.text: Title of head of household once
definitions.meaning: an old title for the master of a house
Benny ... was the American swing-era clarinettist and bandleader

explanation.surface: An old form of address for the man of the house, perhaps a man called Benny.
explanation.definitionFit: In older English the goodman was the husband or master of the household; the jazz musician bore it as a surname.

clue.text: Modest abode originally, and not a landed estate

indicators.note: what something is originally is its beginning, so the first letters of the two words are taken

parts.note: nor means and not

explanation.surface: A humble home at first, now no grand country estate.
explanation.definitionFit: A manor is a country house with its surrounding lands, a landed estate in the feudal sense.

clue.text: Old US president protected by British motorcyclist

indicators.note: something protected is surrounded, so the president sits inside the abbreviation for British

parts.note: Ike was the nickname of Dwight D. Eisenhower, US president in the 1950s

explanation.surface: A former American president guarded by a British rider on a motorbike.
explanation.definitionFit: A biker is someone who rides a motorcycle, a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: Line on map observed at first in island pub

indicators.note: the first letter of observed goes in among the letters for island and pub

parts.note: a bar is a pub

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of observed

explanation.surface: Something spotted on a map at the start of a visit to an island's pub.
explanation.definitionFit: An isobar is a line on a weather map joining points of equal atmospheric pressure.

clue.text: Uneasy, having stirred up trouble

definitions.meaning: the past tense of agitate, to stir up unrest

explanation.definitionFit: Agitated describes nervous unease, and to agitate is to campaign or provoke, hence stirring trouble.

clue.text: Duplicitous lookalike distributing cards at table

parts.note: a double is someone who looks just like another person
dealing is handing out cards in a game

explanation.surface: A doppelganger dealing out cards at a card table, perhaps crookedly.
explanation.definitionFit: Double-dealing describes deceit, acting one way while intending another, so it is a synonym for duplicitous.

clue.text: College class's prescribed clothing

parts.note: uni, short for university, stands for a college
a form is a school class in Britain

explanation.surface: The dress code set for a college class.
explanation.definitionFit: A uniform is the standard clothing laid down for members of a school or organisation.

clue.text: Daughter interrupting a break at sea?

indicators.note: the daughter breaks into the phrase a break, sitting inside it

parts.note: a rift is a break or split

explanation.surface: A daughter cutting a holiday short while on a cruise.
explanation.definitionFit: Adrift means floating without control, so at sea, with the question mark flagging the literal sense.

clue.text: Tree planted in April in Denmark

indicators.note: the tree is planted in the words, its letters set across April in Denmark

explanation.surface: Planting a tree in springtime in Denmark.
explanation.definitionFit: The linden is the lime tree, a common name for trees of the genus Tilia.

clue.text: Theatrical piece by doctor, an arts graduate

parts.note: an gives the indefinite article A
an MA is a Master of Arts

explanation.surface: A play written by a doctor who is also an arts graduate.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama is a play for the stage, a theatrical work.

clue.text: Relax about initiation of important exam

indicators.note: the word for relax goes about, around, the first letter of important

parts.note: to rest is to relax

indicators.note: an initiation is a beginning, so the first letter of important

explanation.surface: Advice to unwind before beginning an important exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A resit is a British term for an examination taken again after failing it the first time.

clue.text: Scorn prophet welcoming knight on board

indicators.note: welcoming someone takes them in, so the knight goes inside the prophet

parts.note: a seer is a prophet
N is the chess notation for a knight, the piece on the board

explanation.surface: A prophet sneering as a knight comes aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A sneer is a scornful look or remark, so the noun is a synonym of scorn.

clue.text: Post a person of masculine gender talked of

indicators.note: talked of means spoken, so the word sounds the same as the answer

parts.note: a male is a person of masculine gender

explanation.surface: A man spoken about in a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Mail and post are synonyms for letters and parcels delivered by the postal service.

clue.text: Bouquet given by a painter accepting high honour

indicators.note: the painter takes the honour inside, accepting it

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a crossword stand-in for a painter
OM is the Order of Merit, a high British honour

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers presented by an artist receiving a top award.
explanation.definitionFit: Bouquet is the scent of a wine, so it is a synonym for aroma; the surface wants it to be flowers.

clue.text: Bizarre situation of constable doing desk job

definitions.text: situation of constable doing desk job
definitions.meaning: a police officer working at a desk is off the beat, not walking the patrol route

explanation.definitionFit: Offbeat means eccentric or unusual, so it is a synonym for bizarre; a constable's beat is a patrol round.

clue.text: Castigate young creature breaking seat

parts.note: a lamb is a young sheep

indicators.note: breaking up the word seat lets its letters be rearranged

explanation.surface: A young animal smashing a chair, which deserves a telling-off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' is the anagram signal, giving ASTE.
explanation.definitionFit: To lambaste someone is to criticise them harshly, a synonym for castigate.

clue.text: Nail leader of rowdies in criminal environment

indicators.note: the leader of rowdies is placed in the word for criminal
the word for criminal forms the surroundings of the letter

parts.note: bad can mean wicked or criminal

indicators.note: a leader goes first, so the first letter of rowdies

explanation.definitionFit: A brad is a thin, small-headed wire nail, so it is a kind of nail.
